correctness.rationale: Frozen RESULT and C++ checker prove exact support existence for A,B iff rank of rows G\B and cols A is below |A|, each A-column deletion leaves rank unchanged, and each demanded Fourier row increases rank. Nonzero kernel coordinate constraints are finitely many proper hyperplanes over infinite cyclotomic field. Independently checked all ranks by two large split-prime reductions: both 100000000000099 and 100000001000377 certified prime by full trial division; ninth roots verified; each k-minor norm bounded by k^(3k)<=9^27 and product primes exceeds bound, proving max modular ranks exactly characteristic-zero ranks. Independently implemented exhaustive all 511^2 nonempty pairs, recovered all 9x9 entries, total 92236, affine 302 and duality 158 orbit-size distributions including all checksums. Original checker.cpp inspected; independent implementation compiled C++17 -O3 and output retained locally. Exhaustiveness is finite for Z9 only, not an infinite-group proof.
